profile.summary: Teach For America is a nonprofit that recruits, develops and supports leaders who teach and work in education. Its Bay Area region places and supports teachers in schools in San Francisco, San Jose, Oakland and Richmond.

sources.title: Teach For America Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Teach For America Inc (EIN 13-3541913, New York NY, 501(c)(3)) confirmed on ProPublica; the TFA Bay Area page confirms Oakland/SF/Richmond/San Jose service, the generic bayarea@ email, and the mission wording the neutral summary paraphrases. The agenda's Bay Area regional office under the national nonprofit fits a talent data sharing agreement; no page names OUSD directly, but nothing conflicts.
